title: A community shoe fitting
passage: At today's free shoe fitting, tell us which foot usually feels tighter. Start with that foot, but try both shoes. Use the chairs by the mirror. For a different size, show the volunteer the tag inside the shoe. Pairs can look alike; the tag identifies the style. Leave any pair that doesn't fit beside your chair so we can sort it by size. Take your chosen pair to the front table.
passageZh: 今天免費試鞋，請告訴我們你平常哪隻腳覺得鞋較緊。先試穿那隻腳，但兩隻鞋都要試。請使用鏡子旁的椅子。要換尺寸時，請向志工出示鞋內標籤。有些鞋外觀相似，標籤能辨識鞋款。不合腳的鞋請留在椅子旁，方便我們按尺寸分類。選好的鞋請拿到前方桌上。
